messages:
olga: Opening follow-up for Seastar Dedicated postmortem. Short cause: VPC peering flapped, on-prem load-balancer re-initialized sessions and our route refresh lagged -> isolated tenant for ~1h. Need concrete owners + timeline for fixes. @ben @rachel please take leads.

ben: From our packet captures it looks like the LB closed TCP sessions and the onprem pushed a partial route update that didn't include the full /24 for ~40m. Two tracks: quick detection + customer compatibility.

rachel: I'll own detection and runbook. Plan: add a prefix-presence synthetic check (poll every 30s), require 2 misses before paging, auto-collect BGP + mgmt logs. ETA prototype 2026-04-04.

matt: I'll coordinate with Seastar ops on their LB image; they run an older vendor release with a known session reset bug. They agreed to a staging probe. I'll propose a canary upgrade and post results.

olga: Draft action items (owner -> ETA):
- ben -> make a short BGP timer tweak PR + test notes -> 2026-03-31
- rachel -> synthetic prefix check + playbook -> 2026-04-04
- matt -> schedule staged firmware probe with Seastar -> 2026-04-06
- ops -> add onboarding field: "LB image + session-reset behavior" -> 2026-04-08

ben: PR draft will include backout steps and lab reconverge numbers. In tests the tweak reduced reconverge median from ~65s to ~14s. Pushing draft today.

rachel: To reduce noisy alerts I'm going to cross-check mgmt-plane reachability before paging. Also will add a checklist item to capture onprem conntrack/port-space during provisioning.

matt: Seastar agreed to a staging window 2026-04-07 02:00-03:00 UTC for a canary upgrade. I'll run our health-checks pre/post and report.

devops-bot: Incident follow-up ticket created: SEASTAR-2026-59-FU. Reminder set for 2026-04-05.

olga: Thanks team. Let's reconvene 2026-04-08 10:00 PT to close items. If we see this crop up for other tenants, flag as "recurring-pattern" and escalate to platform guardrails. Closing thread for now, will reopen with PR and canary logs.
